title: Rastyapa
description: This mod adds variety to the sculk.
body:
This mod was created as a way to breathe new life into sculk and turn it from a purely decorative block into a full-fledged element of the world and its story. It expands the behavior of sculk, adding variety, a sense of “living presence,” and a hidden sense of danger. Sculk now feels less like a simple biome and more like something alien—something that observes and reacts to the player.

The mod introduces new variations of sculk blocks and interactions, making the environment more tense and unpredictable. In some areas, sculk appears calm and almost dormant, while in others it feels active, as if it is slowly spreading and claiming the space around it. This contrast strengthens the atmosphere of exploration and unease.

The main goal of the mod is to deepen immersion. It was developed specifically for my private server with friends, where lore, exploration of abandoned locations, and the feeling that the world hides secrets play an important role. Here, sculk is not just a threat, but a trace of past events—a reminder of a catastrophe and the consequences of forbidden experiments.

The mod does not break vanilla balance; instead, it carefully enhances it, making the exploration of caves, laboratories, and infected zones more engaging, unsettling, and memorable.
